title: Master CSS 'letter-spacing' for Optimal Web Typography & UI Readability
tweet: Elevate your web typography! Discover how mastering CSS 'letter-spacing' improves visual harmony & readability across all devices. Boost UI/UX instantly. #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign
tip: Fine-tuning 'letter-spacing' (also known as 'tracking') is crucial for legibility, especially with various font families and sizes. Overly tight or loose spacing can hinder readability. Use subtle adjustments for headings and larger text to enhance visual appeal, and slightly open up spacing for smaller text blocks to improve distinction between characters. Always test across different devices and font sizes to ensure optimal user experience. Remember that proportional adjustments are key to maintaining a balanced aesthetic.
